title: Subspace-Confined Variational Quantum Algorithms for Constrained Portfolio Optimization
description:
Reference implementation accompanying the paper Subspace-Confined Variational Quantum Algorithms for Constrained Portfolio Optimization (IEEE Transactions on Quantum Engineering).

Contains the CUDA-Q implementation of the soft-penalty (SP) and subspace-confined (SC) ansätze, the C++/pybind11 genetic-algorithm solver used to construct the low-violation working subspace, the experiment scripts with fixed random seeds, the figure-generation scripts, and the script that rebuilds the price dataset from public sources.
